source.display_title: 05/01/2026 - Shaz I.  x Farooq Bey — Closed

prospect.name: Shazad Irani
prospect.location: Da Nang, Vietnam (born and raised in Mumbai, India; Persian heritage)
prospect.occupation: Commercial airline captain; previously an IT professional for about 11 years
prospect.family_status: Married, no children. Wife lost 16-18 kg over the past year through CrossFit and gym training and went part-time to protect her training time.
prospect.training_background: Athletic and active throughout school and university — running, table tennis, soccer, always on a team but never the best. Never been coached. Has held several gym memberships over the past decade and 'barely made it over a week' each time. Trains sporadically at the apartment gym, self-programming from YouTube and Instagram into an Excel sheet, sessions running 1.5 hours. Recently joined a pickleball club. Has met two personal coaches in ten years, the last about two years ago.
prospect.medical: New-onset knee strain that began on the third and fourth days of playing pickleball, first joint symptom he has ever had. Chronic severe sleep restriction from shift-work rostering — waking at 2 a.m. most of the week, four to five hours before a duty day, and describing six hours as 'luxury'. Self-describes as unable to gain weight and reports losing 1-2 kg of water weight in a single session of sport. No back pain, no tennis elbow, no injuries or diagnosed conditions reported. No medications discussed. No health or injury question was asked by the rep at any point.

signals: Explicitly wants a former self back: 'I guess I want to become at least half the man I used to be 10 years ago. I was a completely different person.'
Names a specific lost peak — the four years after his career change when 'I was unparalleled, I was at my peak'
Visible regret and self-reproach: 'I'm just fed up with the way I appear and I look', 'I've been just lazy'
Lost ground to a hard season rather than to a medical event — a decade of 15-hour desk days followed by erratic long-haul rostering
Not the_optimizer: he is not currently fit and is not going good-to-great; not the_preserver: he is 43 and chasing gain, not preservation

goals.text: Look and feel stronger, fitter and bigger — he is a self-described hardgainer who has never been able to put on weight
Become mentally confident and congruent — 'I want to be able to do things that I set down to do, that I say that I'm going to do'
Break the guilt-and-binge cycle and finally be consistent — 'I want to stop pushing things onto the next day'
Get a workout including warm-up down to under an hour so the time cost stops being a reason to skip
Start taking care of his health now that his knees have begun complaining, rather than waiting for the age-related problems he already lectures his parents about
Get onto a proper diet and stop losing weight through training
Follow a structured programme with a real timeline and a deadline so that finishing something becomes possible again

pains.text: Ten-year cycle of procrastination broken only by guilt-driven one-off max-out sessions, after which he does not return for weeks
Erratic long-haul rostering — 2 a.m. wake-ups, 12-hour duty days, four to five hours of sleep, six hours described as a luxury — which he says is what stops him committing to any programme
Chronic sleep debt he has been carrying for years and cannot resolve because he cannot fall asleep in daylight after a duty day
No programme and no goal, so no deadline and therefore no accountability to himself — 'because I never set deadlines, I'm not achieving anything'
Aimless when he does train — 'even on the odd days that I do work out, I'm kind of, I'm aimless, I'm not sure what I'm doing'
Self-programming from Instagram and YouTube into a spreadsheet, which stretches sessions to an hour and a half and becomes its own barrier
Fear of starting because he does not believe he will finish — 'I'm afraid to start because I'm not confident that I'm gonna go all the way'
Daily comparison against younger, visibly fitter co-pilots, and a mirror at home that he says makes him look worse
Previous coaches all demanded a fixed weekly time commitment he cannot give, which is why he has stayed uncoached for a decade
New knee strain from pickleball — the first joint symptom of his life — and a growing worry that he is no longer getting away with neglect
Comfort creep — 'as our lives get more convenient and easier, we let go of the struggles... I'm at that stage now, and it's starting to scare me'

objections.raw_quote: So it's my working hours that are so irregular. They kind of discourage me from committing to a program.
objections.rep_response: Reframed around fit and efficiency rather than running the timing play — positioned the programme as adjusting to his life, 30-minute sessions three to four times a week and five to ten minutes of mobility, and returned to it in the pillar delivery

objections.raw_quote: I'm not sure if this stuff is scientifically proven or not... I see a lot of fitness influencers speaking about diet based on blood groups. And I'm not sure if that's a thing, but if that helps me, I can probably get some tests done.
objections.rep_response: Said high levels of health are achievable without it, that 'the deeper down the rabbit hole you get, you want to be doing it', and deferred the question to Trevor

evidence: Unambiguous verbal agreement to the three-month tier: 'So I'm thinking, let's go with the three-month program. I want to see, because I just want to, I want to commit to the time.'
Confirmed again at the end: 'Happy? You want to rock and roll?' — 'Yes.' — 'Let's do it, man.' — 'Okay, let's do it.'
Rep moved directly into payment capture and disabled the recorder to do it: 'I'll remove my Fathom note-taker, okay? I'm going to take sensitive information.'
Pre-close commitment was clean — a 10/10 on trust in Trevor and 'Yes, I do' to the capability check, both obtained before price was mentioned

COUNTER-EVIDENCE: no payment confirmation, no agreement signature and no onboarding steps are observable, because the recording was stopped at exactly the point the payment step began. The close rests on verbal agreement plus the rep initiating collection, not on evidenced payment.

COUNTER-EVIDENCE: the prospect chose the cheapest tier explicitly as a trial of himself rather than of the programme, and stated at 00:36:44 that his brain was 'almost, like, shutting down' at 11.30 p.m. local after being awake since 6 a.m.
outcome.next_step: Rep to process the $4,000 three-month investment, grant immediate access to the app, programme and community, onboard him, and book the one-to-one call with Trevor the following week

notable.note: Three things a manager should see. First, a sale was closed at $4,000 for three months — a tier that is not in the sanctioned price list — and the rep also quoted a differential upgrade mechanic ('if you want to do six months, you pay 2K instead of another 4K'). Second, the rep disabled the Fathom recorder at the moment payment collection began, which means the entire Payment and Onboarding phase is unobservable for this close and, if it is habitual, for every close in this folder. Third, the rep volunteered that he runs his own private coaching practice alongside this role — 'I don't do coaching, although I coach privately on the side... it's not just the kettlebells... I do a bit of life coaching as well' — said directly to a prospect he was in the process of selling. Separately, not one health, injury or medication question was asked before selling a loaded kettlebell programme to a 43-year-old with new knee pain who sleeps four to five hours a night on a shift-work roster.

quality.notes: Frequent short-turn inversions throughout, and several long passages fully inverted. Clear examples: 'And it makes me look even worse' at 00:06:31 is labelled Farooq Bey but is the prospect describing his own mirror; 'When you really think about it, has that kind of had an impact on you? In what way?' at 00:09:01 is labelled Shazad Irani but is the rep's question; the entire price recitation at 00:41:23 to 00:41:28 alternates labels mid-sentence. Roles were resolved from content. No line-level attribution in this file should be trusted.
